claims.statement: The Services business is expected to remain the primary growth driver, supported by expanding Global Capability Center (GCC) engagements and deeper account mining across strategic customers.

The portfolio mix shift toward higher-value services, combined with disciplined execution and operating leverage achieved over recent quarters, is expected to support margin stability over the medium term.
Growth in the product and ODM portfolio will continue to be calibrated through prudent capital allocation and structured operational oversight.
Q1 FY27 order booking of US$47 million total contract value, including US$34 million new deal wins and five new logos added
claims.value: US$47 million TCV, US$34 million new wins

claims.statement: Annual contract value for Q1 FY27 orders stood at US$40 million, including US$24 million from new wins
claims.value: US$40 million ACV, US$24 million new wins

claims.statement: EBITDA ₹31 Cr at 9.5% margin; EBIT ₹21 Cr at 6.3% margin, down 50 bps sequentially but up 430 bps YoY; PAT ₹23 Cr at 6.9% margin
Cash and investments ₹356 Cr; negative operating cash flows due to working capital consumption, capacity expansion, and inventory build for memory shortage; expect large cash consumption in FY27
Borqs break-even at ~$12M quarterly revenue; currently loss-making but expected to add to bottom line after break-even
No formal guidance given; priority for FY27 is disciplined profitable growth, converting bookings to revenue, improving execution consistency, investing in talent and Chip-to-Cognition capabilities
Management committed to 60x4x3 strategy (60 customers at $4M+ in 3 years, metaphoric timeline); may take 1-2 more years but focus remains intact; adding 5-6 sales heads in FY27
Total contract value signed in Q2 was $47 million, up 66% YoY; $25 million new bookings, rest renewals; annual contract value $34 million
EBITDA margin 12.9% (+330 bps QoQ, +700 bps YoY); EBIT margin 8.9% (+250 bps QoQ, +660 bps YoY); PAT margin 8% (+8.8% QoQ, +143.8% YoY)
Software services expected to deliver single-digit sustained growth above industry average for mid/small tier; product solutions targeting $12-14M/quarter run rate for 10-12% EBITDA margins
Headcount grew 7% QoQ; LTM attrition lowered to 9.3%; utilization improved to 86%
90-95% of H2 service revenues tied up from signed orders; confident on achieving full year numbers; targeting sustained momentum into FY28
Focus on financial discipline and prudent capital allocation while remaining flexible to invest in capabilities and opportunities
